headline: Leno Puts The Numbers On test211
deck: test3331 lead test211 20-13 with a game in hand, Leno the difference in goal
body:
test3331 sit 20-13 up on test211, and with one still to play against test211's two, the arithmetic has all but closed the door. Leno has done the standing work in goal, and the outfield men who blanked around him hardly mattered once the lead was set.

test211 have Castagne, King and the returning Thomas to run down a seven-point gap, and Thomas is the one unknown they can lean on after international duty. It is a lot to ask of two names, and João Pedro is not among them. Barring the absurd, this is test3331's, though football has embarrassed better pundits than this desk.
